第1章(1)
北京城礼亲王府。
细雨纷飞，整座王府沾上一层水气，华贵的亭台楼阁，雅致的回廊花园，尽是湿漉，就连住在里面的人都沉下心来。
王府里一处富丽堂皇的院落，礼亲王甩袖挥落茶几上的瓷杯，砰的一声划破寂静，所有人面面相觑，不敢吭声，一个十五、六岁的少女轻扯福晋的袖子，忧心的指着外头。
福晋万分为难，好半晌才小心翼翼的打破沉默。“王爷，你就先让他进屋里来，有话慢慢说，这外头下着雨──”
“这孽子就是让妳给姑息出来的！”礼亲王勃然大怒，打断她的话。“咱王府的脸面都给他一个人丢尽了，妳还想替他说话！”他火冒三丈的走到门口，指着外头吼骂。
院子里，一道清瘦的身影直挺挺跪在碎石地板上，任由逐渐趋大的雨滴淋在劲瘦修长的身上及清磊斯文的脸上，他却始终动也不动，狭长俊逸的双眸透着郁色，神情凄然。
“雨越下越大，受了风寒事小，若他哮喘的毛病发作起来可就麻烦了。”做母亲的终究心疼儿子，仍硬着头皮劝言。
礼亲王脾气一发不可收拾，听了她的话后犹如火上加油，咆哮出声：“那正好，替咱王府除了一大祸患！我就搞不懂，这全天下女人多的是，他偏要那个被皇太后指婚给别人的格格。他两人要是同心也就罢了，可我听说人家对他根本没那份心思，他却自作多情的跑去求皇太后收回懿旨，还为了那女人硬是不肯接下皇上派遣的调任职务。现在好啦！闹成全京城最大的笑柄，怎么会有这种天字第一号傻瓜！”
原本笔直跪着的人听到父亲的讥讽后，眉眼闪动，显然大受打击，清俊的脸庞倏地泛白，气息开始发急。
“王爷，别再说了。”福晋拉住暴怒的王爷恳求。
“他要是承认自个儿做错了，愿意接受皇上派他到边疆营区视察的职务，那我就原谅他！”礼亲王气吼。
雨势渐大，年方二十初的年轻贝勒衣裳全被雨水湿透，原本黑亮的长辫也已濡湿，水珠不断沿着削瘦的脸颊滑落，他却猛然抬起头来看向满脸怒容的礼亲王。
“孩儿从不后悔，也绝不离开京城，更遑论另娶他人。”嗓子透着杂音，呼吸益发急促起来。
“你这孽子！”礼亲王欲冲出去揪起他，却被几个子女求住，但怒骂的声音却响亮得吓人。“你为什么就这么死心眼？！人家和新婚夫婿感情好得很，根本没把你看在眼里，你执着个什么劲儿！干什么往死胡同里拚命钻！”
“大哥，先跟阿玛认个错就是了！”
“是啊，犯不着和王爷呕气……”
屋内你一言我一语，嘈杂纷乱不休，浑身湿透的年轻贝勒脸色越发苍白，忽然身子一歪，一手撑住地板，一手抓住喉咙，呼吸急乱，斯文的脸孔霎时痛苦万分。
“额娘，大哥哮喘的毛病又发作了！”屋里有人惊呼，所有人都看向屋外。
“快来人！快把大贝勒搀进来！”福晋脸色骤变，礼亲王也被这突如其来的状况吓怔，这哮喘症状不是好些年没发了吗！

年轻贝勒抓着胸口，张嘴不住用力喘气，却像是吸不着空气似的，原本白皙的面孔胀红后又泛青，众人手忙脚乱的想扶他起来，却见他忽然咬牙闷哼，咚一声昏倒在地。
“糟啦！快请大夫来！”
“把大贝勒抬进屋里，谁去他房里拿药来，快快快！”
男子被七手八脚给抬进屋，即使昏了过去，惨白的脸庞却仍是蹙着眉，似是幽结的心事无时无刻都在侵扰着他……
百花争妍的园子里，好些个娇贵的官家千金、年轻格格正悠哉地吃果子喝茶，顺便闲嗑牙聊传闻。
“听说礼亲王府的兰泗贝勒前阵子哮喘发作，差点就不行了，礼亲王还急忙找了宫里的太医前去医治呢。”
“难怪昨儿个我大哥他们办的聚会都没见到他来。”有人暗叹一口气。
“喔，原来妳这么专注着兰泗贝勒的消息？”
“别乱说。”少女娇斥，脸上却现羞怯。
“兰泗哮喘的毛病不是治好了吗？怎会忽然发作？”
“那种打娘胎里带来的病哪有可能根治，好些年没发作可能是身子养得好，现下忧伤过度，很容易再犯的。”
“兰泗贝勒怎么会忧伤过度？”几个千金、格格凑在一起热烈讨论，显然每个人都对兰泗这个话题颇好奇。
“还不就是心上人琵琶别抱，让他大受打击；再加上皇上派遣他远赴边疆营区视察，他不愿意离开京城。为了这事儿，听说礼亲王府里闹得不可开交，礼亲王发了好大一顿脾气，可能就是这样他才会忽然又旧疾发作。”
“这么说来，兰泗贝勒还真是痴情种，为情为爱不惜抗旨，真是痴心啊。”情窦初开的少女语气多所崇拜。
“而且他还生得这么俊雅飘逸，和大多数八旗子弟的粗犷迥然不同……”
“是啊，兰泗可真是咱们京城里罕见的翩翩美男子，清俊高雅，透着一股书卷气质。”
“既然如此，他的青梅竹马怎么会弃他而去？”
一道清澈的声音从角落传来，众家格格全转头看向说话者，是户部侍郎福大人家里庶出的么女初荷，她每次参加聚会，都是静静的坐在角落，就算偶尔没出席也不会有人注意到，惯常独来独往，平时也没见哪家女孩与她特别交好，此刻大伙儿不免有些意外她的发言。
“还不就是那女人没眼光没良心，兰泗守在她身边多年，到最后她才说只把兰泗当大哥，这简直就是铁石心肠嘛。”
“不过也幸好那女人没良心，这下子暗恋兰泗的人可就有机会趁虚而入啦。”

“是啊，他这时候最需要温柔的安慰……”
几个小女生叽叽喳喳，开始讨论找一天前去礼亲王府登门拜访，探视尚在养病的兰泗贝勒。
“咱们可以先说是找敦华，再让她带咱们去她大哥那儿。”有人开心提议。
“敦华？她怪里怪气的，搞不好还让我们吃闭门羹呢。”有人冷哼。
忽然有人看向坐在角落的初荷。“对了，妳不是和敦华还算说得上话吗？妳跟她说说，让她安排咱们去探视她大哥。”
被点名的初荷微微蹙眉。“要去，妳们不会自个儿跟她说吗？”
人人互使眼色，其中一个下巴抬得高高的，颐指气使的问：“只是让妳问问也不成吗？要是妳不问，以后就别来参加咱们的聚会了。”
初荷冷睨她们。“茶艺社竟还有这样的规矩，我怎么不知道？”
几个娇贵的少女没想到竟会被反呛，明显都愣了一下。
“就是有这样的规矩，是咱们规定的，妳不知道而已。”其中一个不服气的哼着。
初荷没动气，内心却感到可笑至极。“既是如此，那我也不想来了。妳们慢慢聊吧，我还有事得先走了。”
众人望着她离去的身影，不满的情绪益发高张。
“真是莫名其妙！竟然说走就走，也不想想刚才她还不是凑在一旁听着。”
“怪人一个！难怪会和那个敦华合得来。”
“喂，跟妳们说个消息，是从我额娘那儿听来的。听说福大人要把初荷许配给简亲王做侧福晋呢。”此话一出，所有女孩儿全惊声怪叫，像是听到什么恶心的消息似。
“真的假的？简亲王不是已经快六十岁了吗？好老喔。”

Chapter 1(1)
Beijing Chengli Prince's Mansion.
The drizzle was falling, and the entire palace was covered with moisture. The luxurious pavilions, pavilions, and elegant cloister gardens were all wet, and even the people living there felt depressed.
In a magnificent courtyard of the palace, Prince Li waved his sleeves and dropped the porcelain cup on the coffee table. A bang broke the silence. Everyone looked at each other and did not dare to say a word. A fifteen or sixteen-year-old girl gently pulled Fujin's sleeve and pointed worriedly outside.
Fujin was extremely embarrassed, and it took him a long time to carefully break the silence. "My lord, please let him come into the house first and speak slowly. It's raining outside─"
"This scoundrel was born just to be tolerated by you!" Prince Li was furious and interrupted her. "Our prince has lost all face to him alone, and you still want to speak for him!" He walked to the door angrily, pointed outside and yelled.
In the yard, a thin figure knelt upright on the gravel floor, letting the increasingly heavy raindrops fall on his thin and slender body and his elegant face, but he remained motionless, his narrow and handsome eyes filled with gloom and a sad expression.
"The rain is getting heavier and heavier. It's not a big deal if he catches the wind and cold. But if his asthma attacks, it will be troublesome." After all, the mother felt sorry for her son, but she still had the guts to persuade him.
Prince Li's temper was out of control. After hearing her words, he seemed to add fuel to the fire and roared: "That's just right, it will eliminate a big disaster for our palace! I don't understand. There are so many women in the world, but he wants the one who was married to someone else by the Empress Dowager. If they are of the same mind, then That's all, but I heard that they didn't care about him at all, but he went to the Empress Dowager to take back the imperial decree, and refused to take the transfer position assigned by the emperor because of that woman. Now, he has become the biggest laughing stock in the whole capital, how could there be such a fool!"
When the man who was kneeling upright heard his father's sarcasm, his eyebrows flashed, and he was obviously greatly shocked. His handsome face suddenly turned pale, and his breath began to become short.
"Prince, stop talking." Fujin grabbed the furious prince and begged.
"If he admits that he made a mistake and is willing to accept the emperor's assignment to inspect the border camps, then I will forgive him!" Prince Li roared angrily.
The rain was getting heavier, and the clothes of young Belle, who was in his early twenties, were completely soaked by the rain, and his long, shiny black braid was also soaked. Water drops kept sliding down his thin cheeks, but he suddenly raised his head to look at Prince Li, who had an angry look on his face.
"My child has never regretted it, and he will never leave the capital, let alone marry someone else." There was noise in his throat, and his breathing became more rapid.
"You evil son!" Prince Li wanted to rush out and grab him, but he was stopped by several of his children, but the scolding voices were frighteningly loud. "Why are you so stubborn?! My relationship with my new husband is so good that I don't take you seriously at all. Why are you so persistent! Why are you trying so hard to dig into a dead end!"
"Brother, just admit your mistake to Amma first!"
"Yes, there is no need to get angry with the prince..."
There was endless chatter in the room, and the soaked young Belle's face became paler and paler. Suddenly, his body tilted, he supported the floor with one hand, and grabbed his throat with the other. His breathing was ragged, and his gentle face was suddenly filled with pain.
"Mom, my brother's asthma has attacked again!" Someone in the room exclaimed, and everyone looked outside the room.
"Come quickly! Bring Big Belle in quickly!" Fujin's expression changed suddenly, and Prince Li was also startled by this sudden situation. Haven't he had asthma symptoms for several years?
The young Belle was clutching his chest, unable to open his mouth and gasping hard, but it seemed as if he couldn't suck in air. His originally fair face turned red and then turned blue. Everyone was trying to help him up in a hurry, but they saw him suddenly gritting his teeth and groaning, and passed out with a thud.
"Oops! Call the doctor quickly!"
"Bring Big Belle into the house, who can go to his room?"Get the medicine, quickly, quickly! "
The man was carried into the house by various hands and feet. Even though he fainted, his pale face was still frowning, as if You Jie's thoughts were bothering him all the time...
In the garden where hundreds of flowers bloomed, many young and elegant daughters of the official family were leisurely eating fruits and drinking tea, while chatting about rumors.
"I heard that Lan Sibeile of Prince Li's Mansion had an asthma attack a while ago and almost died. Prince Li also hurriedly found the imperial physician in the palace for treatment. "
"No wonder I didn't see him come to the party my eldest brother and his friends held yesterday. "Someone sighed secretly.
"Oh, so you are so focused on the news about Lan Sibeile? "
"Don't talk nonsense. "The girl scolded, but her face showed shyness.
“Isn’t Lan Si’s asthma problem cured? How could it happen suddenly? "
"It is impossible to cure a disease caused by beating the mother in the womb. It may have been a disease that has not occurred for many years because the body has been well maintained, but now it is too sad and it is easy for it to happen again. "
"How could Lan Sibeile be so sad? "Several daughters and princesses gathered together for a heated discussion. It was obvious that everyone was curious about the topic of Lan Si.
"It was not only the fact that his sweetheart Pipa didn't hug him, but also the fact that the emperor sent him to inspect the border camps, so he was unwilling to leave the capital. Because of this matter, I heard that there was a lot of commotion in Prince Li's palace, and Prince Li lost his temper. Maybe it was just like this that he suddenly suffered from an old illness. "
"In this way, Lan Sibeile is really an infatuated person. He doesn't hesitate to resist orders for the sake of love. He is really infatuated. "The tone of a young girl who is just beginning to fall in love is admired by many.
"And he is so handsome and elegant, very different from the rough and rough appearance of most of the Eight Banners disciples..."
"Yes, Lan Si is really a handsome man that is rare in our capital city. He is handsome and elegant, with a bookish temperament. "
"In that case, why would his childhood sweetheart abandon him? "
A clear voice came from the corner, and everyone turned to look at the speaker. It was Chu He, the concubine of Mr. Fu, the Minister of Household Affairs. Every time she attended a party, she would sit quietly in the corner. Even if she occasionally didn't attend, no one would notice. She usually walked alone, and she didn't usually have any special friendship with any girl. At this moment, everyone was a little surprised by what she said.
"It's not that that woman has no vision and conscience. Lan Si has been by her side for many years, and in the end she said she only regarded Lan Si as her eldest brother. This is simply a hard-hearted thing. "
"But luckily that woman has no conscience, now the person who has a crush on Lan Si will have the opportunity to take advantage of her. "
"Yes, he needs gentle comfort most at this time..."
Several little girls chattered and began to discuss finding a day to go to Prince Li's Mansion to visit Lan Sibele, who was still recovering from illness.
"We can first say we are looking for Dunhua, and then ask her to take us to her elder brother's place. "Someone suggested happily.
"Dun Hua? She is so weird and eccentric that she might even turn us away. "Someone snorted coldly.
Suddenly someone looked at Chu He who was sitting in the corner. "By the way, aren't you and Dun Hua still on speaking terms? You tell her and let her arrange for us to visit her elder brother. "
Chuhe frowned slightly after being named. "If you want to go, won't you tell her yourself? "
Everyone exchanged glances, and one of them raised his chin high and asked arrogantly: "Can't I just ask you? If you don't ask, don't come to our gatherings in the future. "
Chuhe looked at them coldly. "The Tea Club actually has such rules, why didn't I know? "
Several delicate girls did not expect to be choked, and they were obviously stunned.
“There are just such rules, they are set by us, you just don’t know. "One of them hummed unconvinced.
Chu He was not angry, but felt extremely ridiculous inside. “If that’s the case, then I don’t want to come either. You guys can chat slowly, I have something else to do and I have to leave first. "
Everyone looks forward to itAs she walked away, her dissatisfaction became more and more intense.
"It's really inexplicable! He actually left right away without thinking that she wasn't listening just now."
"What a weirdo! No wonder he gets along with that Dun Hua."
"Hey, I have some news for you. I heard it from my mother-in-law. I heard that Mr. Fu is going to betroth Chu He to Prince Jian as his concubine." As soon as these words came out, all the girls screamed in surprise, as if they had heard some disgusting news.
"Really or not? Isn't Prince Jian almost sixty years old? He's so old."
